snapshot.description: Commit id of the reviewed snapshot, copied from the package.

coverage.description: criteria: checked against the task acceptance criteria; diff_only: the task has none, only the diff was checked.

line.description: Line in the snapshot; 0 when the finding is about the whole file.

rationale.description: Why it is a defect and what breaks.

criterion.description: The acceptance criterion the finding violates, quoted from the task.

previous.description: One verdict per key under Previous findings in the package; a key left out counts as not_checked.

verdict.description: fixed: the defect is gone from this snapshot; still_open: it is still there; not_checked: this snapshot does not let you tell.

note.description: What in this snapshot shows the verdict; required for fixed and still_open.

unchecked_criteria.description: Acceptance criteria you could not check from the diff, quoted from the task.
